steps.en: Install the pack into your agent
steps.zh: 把 skill 包装进你的 agent

steps.en: Registers ~45 Go skill descriptions for on-demand triggering
steps.zh: 登记约 45 个 Go skill 的触发描述

steps.en: Ask the agent to write or review Go, as usual
Loads the matching SKILL.md and applies those rules
steps.zh: 加载对上的 SKILL.md 并按规则写或审

value.en: The agent follows Go conventions and footguns without you pasting Effective Go each turn
value.zh: agent 会按 Go 习惯和踩坑条写，不必每轮把 Effective Go 粘进去

sources: https://github.com/samber/cc-skills-golang README.md — How to use (`npx skills add https://github.com/samber/cc-skills-golang --all`)
https://github.com/samber/cc-skills-golang README.md — Skills section (atomic cross-referencing units; recommended skills ~1,100 description tokens; install all general-purpose together)
https://github.com/samber/cc-skills-golang/skills/golang-error-handling/SKILL.md — description field as the trigger; body loaded when the task matches
